stories.title: Anansi’s Web
stories.tagline: A clever trickster. A tangled plan. A lesson worth sharing.
stories.description: Join Anansi as a clever plan teaches a whole village the power of sharing wisdom.

scenes.label: A VERY CLEVER SPIDER
scenes.title: A jar full of wisdom
scenes.text:
Long ago, Anansi the spider believed he was the cleverest creature in the world. He decided to gather every piece of wisdom and keep it in a clay jar. If he owned all the answers, he thought, no one could ever be wiser than he was.

Anansi tied the jar to his chest and searched the village for the perfect hiding place. But the jar was heavy, and its lid rattled with every step.

vocabulary.meaning: the ability to make good decisions using knowledge and experience
made a series of short, sharp sounds

scenes.objectHint: Tap the glowing jar to hear Anansi’s plan.
scenes.objectMessage: The jar holds every idea Anansi has collected. But can one person truly own wisdom?

scenes.label: A PLAN GOES WRONG
scenes.title: The tree-top problem
scenes.text:
Anansi chose a tall palm tree and began to climb. He tied the jar in front of him, but it kept bumping against the trunk. His son, Ntikuma, watched from below.

“Father,” Ntikuma called gently, “why not tie the jar to your back? Then your hands can hold the tree.”

Anansi froze. His young son had noticed a solution that he had missed. For the first time, Anansi wondered whether keeping all the wisdom had made him less wise.

vocabulary.meaning: an answer to a problem
became aware of something by seeing or observing it

scenes.objectHint: Tap the web to reveal the turning point.
scenes.objectMessage: Ntikuma’s simple suggestion shows that a fresh point of view can solve a difficult problem.

scenes.label: WISDOM IS SHARED
scenes.title: A gift for everyone
scenes.text:
Angry and embarrassed, Anansi dropped the jar. It broke against the ground, and the wisdom scattered like seeds in the wind. The villagers gathered and listened to one another, each sharing what they knew.

Anansi finally understood: wisdom grows when people exchange ideas. No one person can hold every answer. From that day on, the village became a place where knowledge was shared, not hidden.

scenes.objectMessage: The story’s lesson: knowledge becomes more valuable when it is shared.

quiz.question: Why did Anansi collect every piece of wisdom?
choices: He wanted to sell it at the market.
He wanted to be the only creature with all the answers.
He wanted to give it to the king.
He was afraid of the village.

quiz.question: What problem did Anansi face while climbing the palm tree?
choices: The jar kept bumping against the tree.
He could not find the village.

quiz.question: What does Ntikuma’s suggestion reveal?
choices: A different point of view can help solve a problem.

quiz.question: In the story, what does “exchange” most nearly mean?
Which statement best expresses the main idea?
choices: The tallest tree is the safest place.
A clever person never asks for help.
Knowledge is most valuable when people share it.
A jar can hold every answer.

stories.title: The Lost Forest
stories.tagline: One missing trail. Three brave friends. A forest in need.
stories.description: Follow three friends through a mysterious forest as they learn to listen to nature and one another.

scenes.label: THE WRONG TURN
scenes.title: A trail that disappeared
scenes.text:
Mika, Jo, and Ren were hiking along a familiar forest path when a thick silver mist rolled between the trees. The trail markers vanished behind the fog. When the mist cleared, the friends could no longer see the wooden bridge they had crossed.

“We should keep walking,” Jo said quickly. Mika shook her head. “Let’s stop, look around, and listen first.” A quiet rustle came from the ferns beside them.

vocabulary.meaning: a cloud of tiny water drops near the ground
a soft sound made by leaves or paper moving

scenes.objectHint: Tap the fern to discover who is nearby.
scenes.objectMessage: A small forest bird is calling from the fern. Listening carefully may reveal a clue.

scenes.label: FOLLOW THE CLUES
scenes.title: The forest speaks
scenes.text:
Ren noticed tiny footprints in the damp soil. Jo spotted a broken branch pointing toward a narrow stream. The friends compared what they had found instead of arguing about whose idea was best.

Near the water, they heard a bird repeating the same three notes. Mika remembered seeing a painted symbol near the old ranger station. The notes matched the rhythm of the symbol’s markings. Together, the friends followed the stream toward a grove of bright blue flowers.

vocabulary.meaning: slightly wet
a small group of trees

scenes.objectHint: Tap the blue flower to reveal the clue.
scenes.objectMessage: The flowers grow beside the stream. The bird’s call and the painted symbol point in the same direction.

scenes.label: A PATH HOME
scenes.title: The trail we made together
scenes.text:
The blue flowers marked the edge of the ranger station clearing. From there, the friends could see the wooden bridge in the distance. They had not been truly lost; the mist had simply hidden the familiar landmarks.

Before leaving, Mika tied a bright ribbon to a low branch to help other hikers notice the turn. Jo thanked Mika for slowing them down, and Ren added a small trail note to the ranger’s map. They walked home knowing that teamwork means combining different observations into one clear plan.

scenes.objectMessage: The ribbon is a small act of kindness for the next hiker. The friends turned their experience into a helpful clue.

choices: Footprints, a branch, and a bird call
A phone signal and a road sign

choices: A place or object that helps identify a location

quiz.question: What is the main lesson of the story?
choices: Only one person should make decisions.
Teamwork combines different observations into a useful plan.
Birds always know the way home.

stories.title: The Ocean’s Secret
stories.tagline: A hidden message beneath the waves.
stories.description: Dive with Lira and a curious sea turtle to uncover a secret that could protect their reef.

scenes.label: A MESSAGE IN THE REEF
scenes.title: The glowing shell
scenes.text:
Lira was collecting smooth stones near the coral reef when a tiny sea turtle nudged a glowing shell toward her. Inside the shell, a blue light pulsed in a steady rhythm. Lira placed it close to her ear and heard a faint clicking sound.

Her grandmother had once told her that the reef carried messages through sound and movement. Lira wondered whether the shell was asking for help. She followed the turtle toward a patch of coral that looked unusually pale.

Lira wondered whether the shell was asking for help. She followed the turtle toward a patch of coral that looked unusually pale.

vocabulary.meaning: moved or shone in a repeated rhythm
a ridge of rock or coral near the sea surface

scenes.objectHint: Tap the glowing shell to listen for its message.
scenes.objectMessage: The shell flashes in a pattern. Something nearby may be disturbing the coral reef.

scenes.label: WHAT LIES BENEATH
scenes.title: The silent current
scenes.text:
The turtle led Lira to a narrow channel where the water moved more slowly than usual. A torn fishing net was caught between two coral branches. Small fish were struggling to swim through its tangled threads.

Lira wanted to pull the net free immediately, but the turtle circled the coral and pointed toward a sharp hook. She understood that rushing could damage the reef even more. She searched for a safe way to loosen the net without touching the living coral.

vocabulary.meaning: a narrow passage of water
to make less tight or firmly fixed

scenes.objectHint: Tap the trapped net to see the problem.
scenes.objectMessage: The net is tangled around the coral. Careful action is needed to avoid harming the reef.

scenes.label: A PROMISE TO THE SEA
scenes.title: The reef can recover
scenes.text:
Lira called the reef ranger, who brought safe cutting tools and carefully removed the net. The small fish darted back into the clear water. The pale coral still needed time and protection, so Lira helped place a warning marker near the channel.

As the glowing shell dimmed, Lira realized that the message had not been a mystery for her alone to solve. It had been a reminder that every creature depends on a healthy ocean. She promised to share what she had seen and help keep the reef clean.

choices: A torn fishing net tangled in coral

choices: Rushing could damage the coral and the hook was sharp.

What is the central message of the story?

stories.title: The Lantern Keeper
stories.tagline: A fading light. A stormy night. A brave choice.
stories.description: Mira follows a trail of tiny lights to help a coastal village find its way home.

scenes.label: THE LIGHT GOES OUT
scenes.title: A shore without a beacon
scenes.text:
Every evening, Mira helped her grandfather light the old beacon above the fishing village. Its warm glow guided boats safely through the dark water. One night, a sudden gust extinguished the flame. Far below, clouds covered the moon and the returning boats could not see the shore.

Grandfather searched for the spare lamp, but the supply room was locked. Mira noticed a line of tiny lights moving along the cliff path. They looked like fireflies, but they were travelling in a careful pattern.

They looked like fireflies, but they were travelling in a careful pattern.

vocabulary.meaning: a light or signal that guides people
caused a flame or light to go out

scenes.objectHint: Tap the lantern to reveal the first clue.
scenes.objectMessage: The small lights are fireflies gathering near the old signal path.

scenes.label: FOLLOW THE SIGNAL
scenes.title: Fireflies in the fog
scenes.text:
Mira followed the fireflies to a sheltered cave. Inside, she found an old hand lantern and a note explaining how the village once used reflected light to signal boats. The lantern had a cracked glass panel, but its metal frame was strong.

Instead of carrying it alone, Mira asked two neighbours to help. One held the lantern steady while the other polished a bright piece of metal. Together, they aimed the reflected light toward the sea.

One held the lantern steady while the other polished a bright piece of metal. Together, they aimed the reflected light toward the sea.

vocabulary.meaning: bounced back from a surface
protected from wind, rain, or danger

scenes.objectMessage: A reflector can redirect light, making a small flame easier to see from far away.

scenes.label: A SAFE RETURN
scenes.title: The village shines together
scenes.text:
The moving beam reached the boats. The fishermen answered with small flashes from their own lamps and slowly followed the signal toward the harbour. By dawn, every boat had returned safely.

Mira's grandfather thanked the neighbours for helping. He explained that the beacon was important, but the people who cared for one another were the village's strongest guide. Mira wrote the signal instructions beside the lantern so everyone could use it when needed.

scenes.objectMessage: Preparedness and cooperation can guide a whole community through uncertainty.

She wanted them to find the cave

stories.title: The Clockwork Garden
stories.tagline: A quiet garden. A curious inventor. A living puzzle.
stories.description: Noah discovers that a forgotten garden needs patience, observation, and a little teamwork.

scenes.label: A STRANGE DISCOVERY
scenes.title: The garden that stopped
scenes.text:
Behind the town library stood a glasshouse filled with brass flowers and tiny metal birds. The garden had once moved with the sunlight, but its gears had stopped turning years ago. Noah, who loved taking apart old machines, found a note beneath a dusty bench: “The garden wakes when its parts work together.”

He tried turning the largest wheel. Nothing happened. A small mechanical bird clicked once, then became still.

A small mechanical bird clicked once, then became still.

vocabulary.meaning: a yellow metal made by combining copper and zinc
made or operated by machines

scenes.objectMessage: The bird's clicking sound suggests that one gear is trying to move.

scenes.label: THE MISSING CONNECTION
scenes.title: Small gears, big changes
scenes.text:
Noah examined the garden carefully. He found a loose gear near the fountain and a narrow belt hanging from the roof. His friend Inez noticed that the sunlight fell on a small glass sensor at noon. They realized the garden needed both a repaired gear and light reaching the sensor.

They fitted the gear into place and cleared the leaves from the glass. When sunlight touched the sensor, the smallest flowers began to turn.

They fitted the gear into place and cleared the leaves from the glass. When sunlight touched the sensor, the smallest flowers began to turn.

vocabulary.meaning: a device that detects a change such as light, heat, or movement
placed or joined something in the correct position

scenes.objectMessage: The sensor detects sunlight and starts the garden's moving parts.

scenes.label: A GARDEN REAWAKENS
scenes.title: A system of many parts
scenes.text:
One by one, the brass flowers opened. The tiny birds lifted their wings, and the fountain began to turn. Noah and Inez watched the gears move in a careful rhythm. Neither the gear nor the sensor could have restarted the garden alone.

They wrote a simple guide for the library and invited younger children to help care for the glasshouse. Noah learned that solving a problem often means noticing how separate parts depend on one another.

choices: A device that detects a change

choices: Different parts can work together as one system

stories.title: The Mountain’s Echo
stories.tagline: A distant call. A difficult climb. A voice worth hearing.
stories.description: A young climber learns to listen closely and protect a mountain community's shared water source.

scenes.label: THE DRY SPRING
scenes.title: A message from above
scenes.text:
After weeks without rain, the spring that supplied a mountain village began to slow. Lina and her cousin Tomas climbed the old path to inspect the stone channel that carried water downhill. From the ridge, they heard a strange echo: three short calls followed by one long call.

Tomas thought it was only the wind. Lina remembered that the mountain guides used sound signals when fog covered the trails. She decided to listen again before they moved farther.

vocabulary.meaning: a long, narrow high area of land
to examine something carefully

scenes.objectMessage: The repeated call may be a signal rather than a random echo.

scenes.label: READING THE LAND
scenes.title: The hidden channel
scenes.text:
The calls came again from beyond a wall of pine trees. Lina followed the sound and found a fallen branch covering part of the stone channel. Water was escaping into the soil before it could reach the village. Tomas noticed fresh marks on the rocks, showing where the channel had shifted.

They did not try to lift the heavy branch alone. Instead, they marked the location and returned to ask the village repair team for help.

Instead, they marked the location and returned to ask the village repair team for help.

vocabulary.meaning: a passage that carries water
moved from its usual position

scenes.objectMessage: The water is leaking where the channel has shifted and become blocked.

scenes.label: THE ECHO ANSWERED
scenes.title: Water for everyone
scenes.text:
The repair team cleared the branch and reset the stones. Water flowed through the channel again, slowly filling the village reservoir. The three-short, one-long call was a signal used by a guide who had seen the blockage from a lookout point.

Lina and Tomas helped paint a clear marker beside the channel so future hikers could report damage. They understood that listening, observing, and asking for help can protect resources that everyone depends on.
